summary: This function works out a payment due date by taking the reading date, adding 14 days, and moving the date to the next day if that falls on a Sunday.

rules.text: The due date is set 14 days after the reading date, with the time of day removed.
If the calculated due date falls on a Sunday, the due date is moved forward by one day to Monday.
The day-of-week check is done in English, so the Sunday test does not depend on the system's language settings.
